description:
Functional spec/files: JidoChatBridge.from_listener adds a typed private host-request branch before listener_state/State/Jido.Chat dispatch. Thin host handler reuses NodeRouter confidential credential_document Action with trusted connector context and exact binding validation. Move prepare/profile/runtime machinery upstream; host retains configuration policy and existing auth persist/start Actions. Replace authenticate document callback and saved-runtime reconstruction consumers; delete SessionStorage only once all references/tests migrate. No generic arbitrary module invocation.
Tests before code: real Engine/Connect/DB integration for enabled/disabled/archived/revoked credentials, mismatched connector/provider/profile, forged webhook/control envelope, missing context and nil identity, bootstrap before State exists, send-triggered storage callback while State busy (deadlock regression), concurrent durable updates, RAM access authorization, lifecycle/source fencing unchanged. Preserve existing session_storage_test, linked_device/storage_test, credential_documents/concurrency coverage by relocating appropriate assertions; do not weaken them.
Action reuse: reuse credential_document Action through Jido.Exec-owned Engine API/NodeRouter, PairLinkedDevice and ConfirmLinkedDevice for existing authorized flows. Host-only bridge handler returns sanitized result after transaction commit; stores no protocol state. No new Action/tool/workflow exposure; nil actor is not authority, runtime capability explicit and private.
Mocking: external WhatsApp only; real internal authorization/transactions/processes. Docs: services/channels, engine and system-config ownership links. Keep topology/deployment policy host-owned. No credential migration.

New real-State reentrancy regression passes. mix q passed; expanded suites 76 tests + 4 properties, 0 failures. No production People changes. Existing reaction fix preserved.
